title: React Certification Applied Check
description: Apply certification-readiness judgment to capstone, final assessment, rubric, debugging, and mock interview scenarios.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: A capstone works locally but has no README, setup steps, or tradeoff notes. What assessment risk does this create?

options.text: Reviewers may not be able to run or evaluate the work fully

questions.explanation: Certification evidence should make setup, behavior, and decisions clear to reviewers.

questions.prompt: A candidate passes a quiz by memorization but cannot debug a broken effect dependency. What should remediation focus on?

options.text: Hands-on debugging and explaining effect behavior

questions.explanation: Readiness requires applying concepts to real debugging, not just recalling terms.

questions.prompt: A strong final coding submission should include which qualities? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Secrets embedded in the frontend for convenience

questions.explanation: Rubrics typically reward correctness, edge cases, clarity, and safe decisions.

questions.prompt: During a mock interview, the interviewer challenges your use of Context for server data. What is the best response?

options.text: Explain the tradeoff and discuss when a server-state library would be better

questions.explanation: Mock readiness includes defending choices with tradeoffs and alternatives.

questions.prompt: A capstone has a polished UI but fails on empty, loading, and error states. How should a rubric likely treat it?

options.text: As incomplete because user flows and edge cases matter
As perfect because visuals are complete

questions.explanation: Assessment should value behavior and resilience, not only visual polish.

questions.prompt: A debugging scenario shows state updates based on old state after rapid clicks. Which explanation demonstrates readiness?

options.text: Use functional state updates when the next value depends on the previous value
Move the click handler outside React
Use source maps to prevent the bug

questions.explanation: Functional updates are a core fix when next state depends on previous state under rapid updates.

questions.prompt: A candidate cannot finish every extension idea before submission. What is the best choice?

options.text: Ship the core requirements well and document deferred extensions
Commit broken code to show ambition

questions.explanation: Extensions are secondary to a complete, reliable core submission.

questions.prompt: A final self-assessment rates every skill as perfect but gives no evidence. What is missing?

options.text: Concrete examples, test results, project links, or explanations supporting the rating

questions.explanation: Certification readiness should be supported by evidence, not unsupported confidence.
